sentences.japanese: 興ざめの人も、よく知るようになると、かならずしも不快ではない。
sentences.english: Wet blankets are not always unpleasant after you get to know them.

sentences.english: Local industry flourished throughout the land in the Edo period thanks to the promotional efforts by each clan.

sentences.japanese: 陽気な席で、人気者の隣に、興ざめの者が座っていることがよくある。
sentences.english: At a hilarious party, one frequently finds a wet blanket sitting next to the life of the party.

sentences.japanese: 小人はつまらないことに興ずる。
